data.title: Ethereum nears $2,500 as bulls prepare for a st... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum's price is trading around $2,479, up 1.3% in the last day, with a market cap of $302 billion, maintaining its position as the second-largest cryptocurrency. It has gained nearly 30% against Bitcoin this month, signaling strong bullish momentum. The price is testing resistance near $2,500, and a move above $2,550 could trigger a significant upward trend. Despite some bearish momentum indicators, investor sentiment remains optimistic, with some experts predicting a rapid 3x to 5x price increase in the near term.
data.author: Bitcoin
